info.description: Every gadget fitted to a widget is reachable from here.
info.title: serves widget resources.

get.description: The listing names each gadget fitted to it.

parameters.description: only list a [Widget] created after this time
parameters.name: since

Assembly.description:
Assembly composes a Widget with fields of its own, so the finished schema is an allOf whose
sibling arm carries prose.

serial.description: Serial identifies this Assembly on the line.

Catalogue.title: Catalogue keys vendor entries off a pattern, each one a Gadget.

known.description: Known is the one named property beside the patterned ones.

Widget.description:
Each nested shape below puts a doc-link somewhere the document walk has to reach on its own:
composition arms, array items, map values and pattern properties are all schemas of their own.

This also links to the Catalogue, which nothing references — so under PruneUnusedModels the
link resolves to a definition that is no longer in the document.
Widget.title: Widget holds a Gadget.

index.description: Index maps a code to the Gadget it selects.

X-Trace-ID.description: TraceID correlates a request touching a Widget.
X-Trace-ID.name: X-Trace-ID

WidgetError.description:
WidgetError is force-registered at #/responses, so its prose lives in the spec-level response
namespace.

message.description: Message explains why the Widget could not be served.

widgetOK.description: WidgetOK returns a Widget, and carries a header whose prose has to be walked too.
